words.ex_en: Angry demonstrators demanded the resignation of two senior officials.
words.ex_zh: 愤怒的示威者要求两名高级官员辞职。

words.zh: 交付；发表；递送；释放；给予（打击）；给…接生
words.ex_en: The morning mail has just been delivered.
words.ex_zh: 早晨的邮件刚送到。

words.ex_en: Scientists have observed a drop in ozone levels over the Antarctic.
words.ex_zh: 科学家已经观察到南极洲上方的臭氧浓度有所下降。

words.ex_en: We had an understanding that Jean-Claude should never be mentioned.
words.ex_zh: 我们有一个共识，永远不提让－克洛德。

words.zh: 基础；底部；主要成分；基本原则或原理
words.ex_en: Their claim had no basis in fact (=  it was not true  ) .
words.ex_zh: 他们的说法没有事实根据。

words.ex_en: The three sons also contribute to the family business.
words.ex_zh: 3个儿子也为家族企业做贡献。

words.ex_en: protection money
words.ex_zh: 保护费

words.ex_en: We hope the factions will be able to settle their differences (= agree to stop arguing ) by peaceful means.
words.ex_zh: 我们希望各派系能以和平方式解决分歧。

words.zh: 身份；同一性，一致；特性；恒等式
words.ex_en: The identity of the killer is still unknown.
words.ex_zh: 凶手的身份仍未查明。

words.zh: 冠军；标题；头衔；权利；字幕
words.ex_en: "Patience and Sarah" was first published in 1969 under the title "A Place for Us."
words.ex_zh: 《耐心与萨拉》于1969年以《我们的地方》为书名首次出版。

words.ex_en: People have lost faith in the government.
words.ex_zh: 人们已失去了对政府的信心。

words.ex_en: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth.
words.ex_zh: 你们没有必要牺牲环保来促进经济增长。

words.zh: 活的；现存的；活跃的；逼真的
words.ex_en: He’s one of the greatest living composers.
words.ex_zh: 他是仍然健在的最伟大的作曲家之一。

words.ex_en: I’m sure there are some folk who would rather they weren’t here.
words.ex_zh: 我敢肯定有些人宁愿自己不在这里。

words.zh: 原理，原则；主义，道义；本质，本义；根源，源泉
words.ex_en: The general principle is that education should be available to all children up to the age of 16.
words.ex_zh: 总的原则是，16 岁以下儿童都应该能接受教育。

words.zh: 幸存；生还；幸免于；比活得长
words.ex_en: Only 12 of the 140 passengers survived.
words.ex_zh: 140 名乘客中只有 12 人生还。

words.zh: 收集；收割；使…聚集；使…皱起
words.ex_en: A crowd gathered to watch the fight.
words.ex_zh: 一群人聚拢来围观打架。

words.ex_en: I don’t like these layabouts you’re associating with.
words.ex_zh: 我不喜欢你结交的这些游手好闲的人。

words.ex_en: a south-facing aspect
words.ex_zh: 朝南方向

words.ex_en: Successful people often aren’t very good at dealing with failure.
words.ex_zh: 一帆风顺的人往往不太擅长应对失败。
